description: A Windows File Explorer window is open over the ClanGen download webpage. The explorer shows a folder named Clangen containing the Clangen application (5,468 KB) and an _internal folder, both modified 27/05/2026 19:54; the Clangen application is selected (1 item selected, 5,33 MB). The webpage behind it shows the text 'Latest development version: 0a0cc93e0b881b7753a5029987990194d6955090' and 'Proceed with caution! This version can and will break.' No error dialog or crash is visible in this frame.

A terminal window showing a PyInstaller build launch log: 'Running on commit 0a0cc93e0b881b7753a5029987990194d6955090', 'pygame-ce 2.5.3 (SDL 2.30.12, Python 3.12.10)', several libpng iCCP warnings, then 'root - CRITICAL - init.py / log_crash / 74 - Uncaught exception' followed by a Python traceback ending in 'IndexError: pop index out of range'. The call chain is main.py:176 -> StartScreen.py:191 screen_switches -> Screens.py:337 show_mute_buttons -> Screens.py:285 add_to_map -> scripts/ui/focus_matrix.py:70 add_to_map -> scripts/ui/focus_matrix.py:121 adjust_row. The traceback is printed twice, followed by "[PYI-101236:ERROR] Failed to execute script 'main' due to unhandled exception!".
